target: University students (19 to 23) in quantitative courses (Finance, Economics, Accounting, STEM) across Vietnam (UEH, RMIT, FTU, VinUni, HUST) and Global universities cramming 48-72 hours before midterms and finals
where: Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City & Hanoi) and Global (US, UK, EU, AU, Asia) university campuses

segments.name: Global / Western university student (US, UK, EU, AU)
University TA / peer study leader / part-time tutor (VN & Global)

behaviours.name: 48-hour panic crammer
behaviours.how: Starts studying 2-3 days before midterms, overwhelmed by 150+ English/Vietnamese slides, wants the fastest path to passing.

behaviours.name: Free-tool stacker
behaviours.how: Uses free ChatGPT, NotebookLM, Knowt, and campus Zalo/Google Drive exam banks before ever paying.

behaviours.name: Social group studier
behaviours.how: Studies with classmates in Zalo/Messenger/Discord groups, shares summarized PDFs, and competes in quiz rooms.

behaviours.name: Formula-skeptical quant student
behaviours.how: Double-checks every calculation and formula because generic AI tools gave them wrong math before.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter / one-time pass buyer
behaviours.how: Only buys if there is zero auto-renewal risk and convenient local payment (VietQR in VN or Apple Pay globally).

objections: Free ChatGPT, NotebookLM, or campus Drive exam banks already cost $0
AI always hallucinates finance, math, and economics formulas and gives wrong answers
I hate study subscriptions that silently auto-renew after my exam ends
I only cram 48-72 hours before midterms and finals, not every single week
A 15-second timer and 4-second reading lock sounds stressful when I just want fast answers
If a classmate shares a free #pack= link or hosts an /arena room, why should I pay?
In Vietnam I only pay with VietQR/MoMo; globally I don't want another $20/month recurring charge
habits: your Corporate Finance or Microeconomics midterm is in 48 hours and you have 150+ lecture slides to review
your classmates drop past midterms and messy PDFs into a Zalo, Messenger, or Discord group chat
you study late at night in a dorm or campus cafe with your laptop and phone
you already tried pasting lecture PDFs into free ChatGPT or NotebookLM
